title: Size category definition
description: Aerodrome-reference-style aircraft size class. See spec/04-data-schemas.md 'Phase 0/1 content fields' and spec/08-interfaces-core.md §8.11 (SizeCategoryDefinition). Ordinal ordering is what stand compatibility (spec/12-interfaces-airside.md §12.7) compares against.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never derived from array position.

ordinal.description: Unique across all size category files; ascending order is smallest to largest (08 §8.11 loader validation).
